subject: Quarterly kickoff: cross-org OKR matrix for review and sign-off
body:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com, marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com, evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quarterly kickoff: cross-org OKR matrix for review and sign-off

Team — attaching the consolidated OKR matrix for Q1 and the slides we'll use for next week's leadership kickoff. This version folds in feedback from product, infra, and sales; the highlights: 

- Objective A (Serving runtime reliability): proposed SLOs and a bounded remediation runway (OKR-1.1 / OKR-1.2).
- Objective B (Unit cost reductions): short list of quantization + batching pilots tied to cost-per-token targets (OKR-2.x).
- Objective C (Enterprise adoption): mutual action plan with Acme pilot and marketplace listings (OKR-3.x).

Asks: 
1) Please review tab "Owner + Metrics" and set any owner clarifications by EOD Thu.
2) Any metric thresholds that you cannot endorse, comment inline in the sheet.
3) Laura and Vivek: we need sign-off on the final set by Fri COB so we can publish to all orgs Monday.

Attachments: Q1-OKR-Matrix.xlsx (master matrix), Q1-Alignment-Slides.pdf (leadership deck)
Drive link: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1a2b3cQ1R4/view?usp=sharing

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
VP, Programs | Redwood Inference
---

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>, laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com, evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quarterly kickoff: cross-org OKR matrix for review and sign-off

Thanks, Olga — reviewed the runtime SLO line items. Two quick notes: 
- OKR-1.2 (99.9% p99 tail) feels aggressive for the new multi-model routing latency; recommend we set a phased target (99.7% -> 99.85% -> 99.9%) mapped to infra rollouts. I'll add a comment in the sheet.
- On piloting quantization for cost, we should keep a guardrail for output quality regression tests; I've linked the eval harness in a comment.

I'll mark a couple owner clarifications. Happy to sync 30m if helpful.

— Vivek
SVP, Serving Runtime
---

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>, laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com, evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 11:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quarterly kickoff: cross-org OKR matrix for review and sign-off

Olga — looked through the sales enablement rows. A couple of small requests from my side: 
- For OKR-3.1 (Acme pilot scoping), add "success criteria: 10% lift in API adoption within 90 days" so CS and Sales have a measurable target.
- Can we add a row for marketplace listing cadence? Marcus (from Product Partnerships) should own it but will need support from Legal on AMCs.

I added the two lines and flagged them as "Marcus: proposal". Otherwise looks good.

Marcus Lin
Head of GTM Strategy
---

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>, vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com, marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com, evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 13 Jan 2027 09:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quarterly kickoff: cross-org OKR matrix for review and sign-off

Thanks for driving this, Olga — I reviewed and the changes from Vivek and Marcus look reasonable. I approve the matrix with the incremental phasing for OKR-1.2. 

Please proceed to publish the matrix to the broader org after Evelyn confirms the support plan for Q1 ramp.

Laura Bennett
Chief Operating Officer
Redwood Inference
---

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>, laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com, marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 14 Jan 2027 12:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quarterly kickoff: cross-org OKR matrix for review and sign-off

Olga — quick operational ask: please add a short contingency runbook under the "Risks & Mitigations" tab that covers rollback triggers and pager ownership for the first 6 weeks of the ramp. Otherwise, I'm good to publish.

Evelyn Hart
VP, Customer Success
---

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com, marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com, evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com, Sarah Cho <sarah.cho@acme.com>, Josh Patel <josh.patel@acme.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Jan 2027 17:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quarterly kickoff: cross-org OKR matrix for review and sign-off

Thanks all — updated the matrix with Vivek's phased SLO, Marcus's success criteria, and a short rollback/runbook under Risks & Mitigations (see tab "Runbook_v1"). Publishing to the company page now and adding the leadership deck to the calendar invite for next Tuesday's kickoff.

Sarah/Josh — linking the Acme pilot plan here so you can see the success criteria and timelines. We'll ask for an initial kickoff next week to align scopes.

Final attachments: Q1-OKR-Matrix.xlsx, Q1-Alignment-Slides.pdf
Drive: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1a2b3cQ1R4/view?usp=sharing
